text:
Alex: Quick sync — Wednesday launch checklist. Need: final changelog URL, docs link bundle, canary timing, and webinar CTA copy. Can eng confirm canary window and any feature flags?
Maria: I can have docs anchor pages + FAQ ready by EOD. Will post links here when published. Do we want an abbreviated release notes or full changelog first?
Alex: Abbrev for the announcement (top 3 bullets) + link to full changelog. Marketing will pull the bullets. Maria, short bullets ok?
Maria: Yep. I'll write 3 bullets + one-liner summary. Will add full changelog under /changelog/v2-3 once TJ confirms deploy.
TJ: Can confirm deploy cadence. Planning canary Wed 09:00–11:00 PT, ramp at 13:00 PT if no major regression. Feature flag: new-routing-turnstile. Canary cohort = 5% of traffic.
Sam: SRE ok with that window. We'll watch latency and error-rate dashboards; rolling rollback plan in place. Alert runbook pinned to #eng-oncall.
Nina: Webinar is scheduled Thu 10am PT — marketing needs a CTA in the announcement pointing to registration page. Also routing needs to include inbound lead tags: source=launch, campaign=mar24-launch.
Alex: Got it. We'll add CTA and hidden UTM params for lead routing. Maria, can you include example docs link + registration link in the bundle you post?
Maria: Yes — will include:
- Changelog short: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/v2-3
- Full notes: https://docs.redwood.ai/changelog/v2-3/full
- Webinar reg: https://redwood.ai/events/mar24
Alex: Perfect. TJ — can you drop the exact feature flag name and any consumer-facing caveats? Marketing needs to avoid promising broken parts.
TJ: Feature flag = `new-routing-turnstile`. Caveat: beta only for dedicated and private deployments, hosted unaffected. I'll add a short note.
DeployBot: Canary scheduled by @TJ for 2026-03-25T16:00:00Z (window 2 hours). Monitoring hooks enabled.
Sam: Small ask — can we delay public announcement until we hit +1h of canary with no regressions? That gives SRE time to triage.
Alex: Yes — we'll hold the public post until 10:00 PT ramp check. If all green, send at 13:15 PT. If issues, we'll use a holding message and postpone webinar CTA.
Nina: If postponed, marketing contingency: convert announcement to "early access" blog and push webinar invitation to next week. Good fallback.
Alex: OK, action items:
- Maria: post docs + changelog links here by EOD. (Maria)
- TJ: confirm canary exec + paste any caveats. (TJ)
- Sam: monitor canary and update in this thread. (Sam)
- Nina: pre-draft CTA + UTM copies and a contingency plan. (Nina)
I'll compile announcement copy once links land. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
